name: Trump Cliff Villas | description: Trump Cliff Villas at AIDA, Muscat: fully furnished 3-bedroom villas with private pools, 130m above sea level. December 2028. Developed by DarGlobal.
Q: What are Trump Cliff Villas at AIDA?
A: Trump Cliff Villas are a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom sea-view villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly beside the Trump International Hotel at 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with a private pool overlooking the sea. Villas are designed and furnished to the highest standard, with every detail specified down to specification.
Q: What are the villa sizes and unit types available?
A: Trump Cliff Villas offer three-bedroom furnished residences from 128 to 166 sqm. Each villa includes a private pool with sea views. Owners receive a Trump International Golf Club Social Membership as part of the purchase and have the option to reside in or lease the villa.
Q: What does the Trump Cliff Villas offer that other AIDA products do not?
A: Trump Cliff Villas offer full villa ownership with a private pool, the closest positioning to the Trump International Hotel, and the most elevated sea views on the AIDA estate. Unlike Trump Golf Villas, which face the golf course, These villas are positioned on the cliff edge with direct sea orientation. Both villa products sit within the same AIDA estate and share access to the same championship golf course and community facilities.

Q: What is Trump International Hotel Oman?
A: Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.
Q: What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?
A: Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.
Q: What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?
A: The hotel offers rooms, junior suites, and suites ranging from 43 to 138 sqm. All units are managed by Trump Hotels as part of the hotel's operational inventory, ensuring professional management and a consistent stream of bookings.

title: Best Countries for Luxury Real Estate Investment in 2026

Foreign Exchange Protection: The UAE Dirham has remained pegged directly to the US Dollar for decades, eliminating foreign exchange volatility for investors funding acquisitions in USD.
Robust Rental Returns: Prime communities such as Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi consistently yield gross rental returns between 6% and 8% annually.

title: Commercial vs Residential Real Estate
heading: Key Takeaways
text:
Key Takeaways
Commercial and residential real estate offer distinct investment advantages, with residential properties typically offering lower entry barriers and commercial assets promising higher returns.
Residential properties, such as villas and apartments, are easier to finance, benefit from consistent housing demand, and offer flexible lease terms and tax exemptions, making them ideal for long-term, stable investments.
Commercial properties, such as office buildings and retail spaces, offer higher rental yields, longer lease tenures, faster appreciation, and various tax deductions; however, they require larger capital and involve more complex regulations.
Residential investments are generally easier to manage, whereas commercial properties require higher maintenance standards and compliance with business-specific regulations due to their unique needs.

title: Commercial vs Residential Real Estate
heading: Key Takeaways
text:
Global trends indicate a growing interest in smart, sustainable homes among residential buyers, while flexible workspaces, logistics hubs, and eco-certified buildings are reshaping commercial demand.
The right investment path depends on your capital, risk appetite, and return expectations. Residential investments suit cautious, long-term investors, while commercial investments are better suited for those seeking a higher ROI with a larger budget.

title: Commercial vs Residential Real Estate
heading: Understanding Residential Real Estate
text:
Understanding Residential Real Estate
Residential property is land intended for human habitation. There are apartments, villas, row houses, and standalone houses. These houses are constructed to provide comfort and safety to individuals, couples, or families. Places are commonly family-oriented and close to schools, hospitals, parks, and city centers.
At DarGlobal, our projects, like The Astera , Interiors by Aston Martin in Dubai or the luxurious D Villas , are perfect examples of residential properties. They meet the needs of modern families and investors who want attractive living spaces with long-term value.

title: Commercial vs Residential Real Estate
heading: Key Benefits Of Investing In Residential Real Estate
text:
Key Benefits Of Investing In Residential Real Estate
Residential real estate comes with many advantages for both new and experienced investors:
Consistent Demand For Housing: Everyone needs a home, which provides steady demand and ensures rental revenue and property appreciation.
Lower Threshold Entrances: Purchasing a home or apartment costs less than commercial property.
Flexible Leasing Options: Smaller lease terms (commonly 11–12 months) allow for flexibility in resetting rents according to market or tenant requirements.
Tax Advantages: Investors can benefit from home-loan deductions and rental income exemptions, making expenses simpler.

title: Commercial vs Residential Real Estate
heading: Understanding Commercial Real Estate
text:
Understanding Commercial Real Estate
Commercial property is property occupied for business. This encompasses office buildings, computer parks, shopping stores, warehouses, and restaurants. These are intended for commerce and are usually built in business districts, industrial parks, or commercial thoroughfares.
DarGlobal has been a major player in commercial real estate as well. Trump International Tower Dubai is a perfect example of our upscale retail units showcasing the viability of commercial properties that can secure high-value tenants.

title: Commercial vs Residential Real Estate

text:

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: Do You Pay Council Tax On An Empty Property: 2025 Rules, Exemptions, And Charges Explained
text:
Do You Pay Council Tax On An Empty Property: 2025 Rules, Exemptions, And Charges Explained
Having an empty property comes with its expenses and liabilities. One of them is the council tax, which is charged on the majority of residential properties. So, even if your property is empty, you might still be charged for it. In 2025, the council tax on empty homes will be made more specific, with different prices depending on the length of the property's vacancy.
That is why investors and property owners need to be aware of these rules to plan their finances better and avoid paying unnecessary penalties. Thus, in this DarGlobal guide, we will explain how council tax is charged to empty properties, available exemptions, the empty property premium, and ways to reduce it legally.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: Key Takeaways
text:
Key Takeaways
The blog outlines council tax laws on vacant homes in 2025, including charges and exemptions.
Council tax is payable on empty homes, with the tax depending on size, category, and council policy.
There are a few misunderstandings that can confuse, such as that probate properties are always excluded.
Certain empty properties are exempt, including those in probate or exceptional circumstances.
Keeping the property unoccupied for too long may lead to an empty property premium, the costs of which escalate over time.
There are certain legal ways of evading council tax payment, such as letting property or guardianship.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: Do You Pay Council Tax on an Empty Property in 2025?
text:
Do You Pay Council Tax on an Empty Property in 2025?
Yes, you will be required to pay council tax even if you are not living in your home. The amount of discount varies with the location. However, some councils offer no discount at all.
Also, if your house has been empty for a year or more, you will be charged an additional premium called the empty home premium. The longer the house has not been used, the more this premium can be. For example, a house empty for ten or more years can be charged four times the basic council tax.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: Do You Pay Council Tax on Empty Property: Common Misconceptions?
text:
Do You Pay Council Tax on Empty Property: Common Misconceptions?
Most homeowners believe that when a home is empty, council tax is not due. This is not necessarily the case in most situations. Council tax is based on the property type and value, not occupancy.
Another frequent misconception is that all inherited property automatically becomes exempt from council tax. Although there can be interim exemptions upon the issue of probate, these do not apply indefinitely .

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: Council Tax Exemptions for Empty Properties
text:
Council Tax Exemptions for Empty Properties
Some empty properties are completely exempt from council tax. The exemptions apply in some cases and are most commonly related to the condition of the property or the property's owner.
If the property owner is in prison, living in a hospital, or a care home for long-term care, the property is exempt. Repossessed houses, houses that are legally uninhabitable, or houses subject to compulsory purchase, become exempt.
If the owner is deceased, council tax is not due until probate is granted, provided the property is unoccupied. Exceptionally, a further six months' exemption may be granted while the property is unoccupied and in the name of the deceased.
Another situation when you will not have to pay this premium is if the property is an annexe, or you are in the military and need to live in accommodation provided.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: Council Tax Exemptions for Empty Properties
text:
You can also avoid the premium for up to 12 months if the property has recently been inherited through probate, is on sale or for letting, or is being thoroughly renovated or undergoing structural work.
Empty Property Premium: What Happens If a Property Is Left Vacant Too Long?
The empty homes premium is an added charge on basic council tax for homes that are unfurnished and vacant for extended periods. The amount increases the longer they have been vacant, to encourage owners to refurbish and occupy premises.
If a property has been kept vacant for over two years, the premium can be 100% of the usual bill. It can be 200% after five years and 300% after ten years. Hence, keeping a property vacant for a long period of time can actually be very costly.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: How to Avoid Paying Council Tax on an Empty Property (Legally)
text:
How to Avoid Paying Council Tax on an Empty Property (Legally)
There are legally permissible ways of reducing or phasing out the council tax payment on an empty property. You can legally avoid paying the council tax in a few situations, like:
If you are undertaking major renovation work, or the owner is in long-term care.
If you rent out the property. It will transfer the council tax responsibility to the tenants.
If you appoint a property guardian who can keep the property occupied without the need to enter long-term tenancies.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: How to Avoid Inheritance Tax on Property?
text:
How to Avoid Inheritance Tax on Property?
Inheritance tax can be significantly high and impose heavy tax liability on your loved ones. There are, however, methods of reducing this payment.
You are not subject to inheritance tax if you leave your assets to a spouse, civil partner, charity, or certain organizations.
If your estate goes to a direct descendant when your spouse dies, additional allowances may apply, potentially making up to £1 million of assets tax-free.
Gifts during your lifetime can also lower the taxable value of your estate .

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: How Much Is Capital Gains Tax on Property in 2025?
text:
How Much Is Capital Gains Tax on Property in 2025?
Capital gain tax should be paid on the profit made when you sell a property. The profit is calculated by subtracting the cost price and allowable expenses from the selling price. Allowable expenses include legal costs, additions, and certain professional fees.
Once your gain is calculated, tax allowances and reliefs payable each year are added to determine how much tax is payable. The rate is determined by your tax band and the type of property disposed of.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: How to Work Out Capital Gains Tax on Property?
text:
How to Work Out Capital Gains Tax on Property?
To determine your capital gains tax, determine how much you paid for the property when you purchased it and how much you sold it for. If you received the property as a gift or inheritance, the market value can be substituted for the sale price.
You may claim the cost of buying, selling, and improving the property, but not maintenance. There are also reliefs if the property was your main home, a business asset, or occupied by a dependent relative.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: When Do You Pay Capital Gains Tax on Property?
text:
When Do You Pay Capital Gains Tax on Property?
Capital gains tax must be paid and reported within 60 days of the property sale. The amount and terms would depend on your tax residency, which is determined by the Statutory Residence Test . Be cautious of fraud where it is claimed that capital gains tax must be paid before releasing sale funds . Always call HMRC to get formal payment details.

Conclusion
In 2025, council tax on empty properties is becoming more targeted, with stricter rules and higher premiums for long-term vacancies. While exemptions exist for certain situations—such as probate, long-term care, or military service—most empty homes will still incur charges, and these can escalate significantly if the property remains unoccupied for years. title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
text:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
1: Do you pay council tax on an empty property?
Yes, normally you will be charged council tax on empty houses, but you can get discounts or exemptions depending on the structure of your local council and your circumstances.
2: Can you be fined for not paying council tax on vacant homes?
Yes, failure to pay council tax can result in fines, prosecution in the courts, and additional charges, even if the property is empty, so make sure to pay your council tax timely.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: 3: Are probate properties exempt from council tax?
text:
3: Are probate properties exempt from council tax?
Yes, probate property is exempt from council tax until probate is granted . A further six months' relief is granted in specific situations where the property is vacant and still in the name of the deceased.
4: How can I reduce capital gains tax when selling property?
You can reduce capital gains tax on selling a property by deducting allowable expenses, claiming reliefs, and using your annual tax-free allowance before calculating your gain .

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
heading: 5: What’s the difference between inheritance tax and capital gains tax?
text:
5: What’s the difference between inheritance tax and capital gains tax?
Inheritance tax is charged on the value of an estate after death. Capital gains tax is charged on the profit from selling an asset during your lifetime.

The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is experiencing a historic boom in foreign investments. Under Vision 2030, the Kingdom is seeking diversification of its economy, reducing its dependence on oil, and attracting foreign investment in other sectors, such as real estate, healthcare, and fintech.

Saudi Arabia is opening its real estate market to foreign investors through reforms and mega projects.

title: Foreign Investment in Saudi Arabia: Key Opportunities & Legal Insights

Understanding Saudi Arabia’s Investment Landscape
The Saudi real estate sector is witnessing brisk growth while maintaining investor confidence and government patronage. It is expected to reach a value of US$2.47 trillion by 2029. Home ownership reached 63.7% by 2023, and the government has set a target to reach 70% by 2030, with encouragement being placed on both domestic and foreign investments in Saudi Arabia in the housing sector.
Real Estate And Economic Development: The real estate sector is boosting the economy in various ways. As new developments become a reality, they spur other sectors such as finance, tourism, infrastructure, and hospitality. This forms a cycle of growth throughout the economy.

Overview Of Foreign Investment Law
Saudi Arabia recently modified its foreign investment law. The new act supplants the previous 2000 act and enhances legal transparency and justice.
Equal Treatment And Simplified Procedures: The new legislation puts Saudi and foreign investors on equal footing in similar circumstances. It increases investor confidence and provokes further involvement.
Instead of a licence, registration is now required for investors. This faster and more streamlined method eliminates delays.
Enhanced Investment Protection: Investors are safeguarded against discrimination by law and enjoy legal remedies in the event of a grievance.

Employment Generation: Real estate generates construction, sales, property management, and ancillary jobs. Employment of this type assists in decreasing unemployment and generating local expertise.
Economic Synergy: New development brings new infrastructure in the form of roads and utilities. This is better city planning and is beneficial for local commerce. The expansion also promotes tourism and hospitality through building attractive destinations and improved amenities.

Strategic Government Investment Initiatives
The Saudi government is also investing heavily in the development of housing and cities. Here are a few government initiatives that are taken by the Saudi government to enhance foreign investments:
Vision 2030 And Housing Programmes: Vision 2030 aims for a balanced, diversified economy. The housing programmes, like the Sakani Program, provide Saudi citizens with housing and financing alternatives. It also creates demand for new development.
Mega Projects And Urban Development: Huge initiatives, such as NEOM and Qiddiya, are gaining international interest. These initiatives hold long-term potential for growth.

title: Foreign Investment in Saudi Arabia: Key Opportunities & Legal Insights
heading: Economic Outlook And Investment Reports
text:
Economic Outlook And Investment Reports
Saudi Arabia recorded strong FDI growth in 2021 and 2022, and then had a fall in 2023. The country got good credit ratings from international institutions like Fitch and Moody's. This reflects a healthy economic future in Saudi Arabia.
Governance Reforms And Investor Confidence: The government has implemented measures to provide transparency and combat corruption. Such reforms have improved the business environment. Saudi Arabia's high ranking in regional governance indexes encourages other foreign investors to join in.
Demographic Trends: The Saudi population is growing, and the life expectancy is rising. Increasing numbers of foreigners are also moving to the Kingdom to work and invest, owing to several opportunities.

title: Foreign Investment in Saudi Arabia: Key Opportunities & Legal Insights
heading: The Vision And Growth Of The Public Investment Fund (PIF)
text:
The Vision And Growth Of The Public Investment Fund (PIF)
The Public Investment Fund (PIF) is the focal point of Vision 2030. It invests across different sectors with the goal of diversifying the economy. PIF is striving to establish Saudi Arabia as a world investment hub. It is investing in local companies and collaborating with international investors.
Strategic Investments And Economic Diversification: The PIF has the goal of managing more than $2 trillion of assets by the year 2030. It is investing in tourism, technology, and entertainment, among others, reducing the Kingdom's dependence on oil and enabling the growth of new segments of the economy.
Job Creation And Global Partnerships: The PIF has created thousands of jobs, both direct and indirect. It works with overseas investors to bring in huge projects, creating enhanced job creation and global partnerships.

title: Foreign Investment in Saudi Arabia: Key Opportunities & Legal Insights
heading: Key Investor Laws And Regulatory Framework
text:
Key Investor Laws And Regulatory Framework
The Saudi Investment Law (SIL) is the primary legal framework for foreign investors. It promotes fairness and ease of doing business.
Streamlined Registration And Rights Of Investors: Overseas investors are registered with the Ministry of Investment instead of seeking a license. This reduces bureaucracy and speeds up the process. It also protects against unjustified appropriation of assets and defends investor rights in case of a conflict.
Investment Incentives And Exclusions By Sector : Investors may be provided tax relief or subsidies in order to work in priority sectors based on impact and eligibility.

title: Foreign Investment in Saudi Arabia: Key Opportunities & Legal Insights

Navigating The Investor Journey And Support Services
Saudi Arabia offers a clear path for foreign investors in its "Invest Saudi" initiative. It helps with regulations, permits, and awareness of the business environment. I nvest Saudi also simplifies the permits and documentation needed to start doing business. This allows investors to focus on business planning and development.
Enhancing Competitiveness: Role Of The National Competitiveness Center
The National Competitiveness Center (NCC) aims to promote Saudi Arabia's ranking in the international economy. NCC finds opportunities and suggests means of improvement for the private as well as public sectors. It makes sure that national reforms are synchronized with global best practices. This enhances the nation's attractiveness to foreign businesses.

Saudi Arabia is diversifying from oil by opening new industries to foreign investment in KSA. Segments like clean energy, logistics, healthcare, and fintech are growing extremely fast, promising high long-term return potential.
The government is investing in solar and wind energy. The shift towards green energy is providing new avenues to foreign firms.
Real estate remains a top investment sector with urban expansion and luxury developments driving demand.
Saudi Arabia is constructing new hospitals and expanding access to healthcare. The logistics sector is also expanding with the ideal geographical location of the nation.
Fintech is also expanding, with initiatives towards digital banking and payment.

Challenges And Risk Factors For International Investors
Investing in Saudi Arabia is riddled with opportunities, but there are risks too. Investors need to be aware of laws and local traditions to succeed and to avoid the risks with careful planning and advice.
Legal and Regulatory Compliance: It is essential to know Saudi law before entering the market. Such laws include property ownership laws, labour laws, and finance laws. It ensures smoother management of complex processes and avoids fines.
Cultural Considerations: Saudi Arabia also has its own traditions and business practices. Establishing trust and sensitivity towards local customs can facilitate business transactions and make them more successful.

Dubai Villa Market Overview

title: How to Buy a Villa in Dubai: Costs, Process & Best Areas
heading: Types of Villas Available in Dubai
text:
Types of Villas Available in Dubai
Dubai's villas are segmented into different categories to meet various demands and budgets:
Townhouses: Generally, 2-4 bedrooms; these are smaller and more community-based, hence, a family can buy an affordable villa of good quality in a nice community.
Semi-detached Villas : More private than townhouses, these have one wall in common with a neighboring property and usually have private gardens.
Independent Villas: Detached houses with the most privacy; generally, they have large gardens, pools, and entertainment areas.
Luxury Mansions: Top-tier real estate in the most exclusive areas, characterised by custom-built architecture, smart home technology, and luxury hotel-style facilities.

Emirates Hills: If you wish to live in luxury and have privacy, this gated community with stylish villas surrounded by green areas and beautiful views of the golf course is the place to be.
Arabian Ranches: A great place for families and close to good schools, it has a distinctive Spanish, Mediterranean style with mature trees and greenery.
Dubai Hills Estate: A development with a mix of city life and nature, it is very well located in the center of the city with great transport links.
Palm Jumeirah: The perfect place for those who desire a luxurious lifestyle, it is an internationally recognized waterfront living with direct beach access and breathtaking views.

heading: Legal Requirements for Villa Purchase
text:
Legal Requirements for Villa Purchase
No restrictions apply for foreigners when buying villas in freehold areas that are specially designated. Among the requirements are a valid passport, a UAE residence visa (which is recommended but not mandatory), proof of funds, and a local bank account for transactions. Mortgages for non-residents can be obtained for up to 50% of the property value, whereas residents may get financing of up to 75%.

title: How to Buy a Villa in Dubai: Costs, Process & Best Areas
heading: Step-by-Step Villa Buying Process
text:
Step-by-Step Villa Buying Process
Learning how to buy a villa in Dubai involves several clear steps. The initial thing to do is to set a budget and a location of your preference. Then, hire a licensed real estate agent to find the right properties for you. The moment you locate your dream villa, present an offer and discuss the conditions.
Paying a deposit (about 10%) and signing a Memorandum of Understanding after settling on the price is customary. Conduct due diligence, which includes property inspections and checking the title of the property, along with obtaining a bank loan if necessary, should be the next steps before the actual sale. The sale will be executed at the Dubai Land Department where ownership will be transferred and the fees payable. In the end, you get your title deed and the keys to your new home.

text:
How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors
Buying property in London continues to be a highly appealing opportunity for both UK residents and overseas investors. Whether you're aiming to purchase your first investment home or expand an existing portfolio, learning the full process is crucial. This guide takes you through everything you need to know about how to buy property in London, from legal steps to financing options.

title: How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors
heading: Key Takeaways
text:
Key Takeaways
No limitations are imposed on foreign buyers; they can enjoy the same legal ownership as UK residents. The requirements are a valid ID, proof of funds, and address verification.
Usually, buy-to-let loans require a 25% deposit. At the same time, non-residents need a 30-40% deposit, and they should get a loan from either a UK or an international lender to finance the property.
The total transaction costs are around 3-5% of the property value. The expenses include Stamp Duty (5%+ over £250,000), legal fees, surveys, and mortgage arrangement charges.
The strategic location selection across the East, South, North, and West London districts helps investors to maximize rental yields and the potential for capital appreciation.

title: How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors
heading: Key Takeaways
text:
The rental income is taxed at the marginal rates. Besides that, there is a 24% Capital Gains Tax on the profits plus a 5% Stamp Duty surcharge on additional properties.
London Property Market Overview (2025)
London's real estate sector continues to display durability despite worldwide economic changes. Average house prices stay powerful, with prime central districts posting steady gains. The rental market is especially strong, propelled by constant demand from professionals, students, and overseas workers. For investors, this offers a stable setting with prospects for both rental yields and capital growth.

title: How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors
heading: Legal Requirements and Eligibility
text:
Legal Requirements and Eligibility
Non-UK citizens can buy a home in London just as easily as UK citizens. If you are a resident in the UK or buying a property from overseas, you both have similar legal rights to own property. To complete the transactions without any hitch, you will require proper identification, proof of address, proof of funds, and it would be best if you have a UK bank account.
Types of Property Investment Strategies
When considering how to buy an investment property in the UK, selecting a plan that is compatible with your aims would be wise:
Buy-to-Let: Acquire a property to lease and earn income from it regularly. This is still the method most people favour to create passive income.
Capital Growth : Focus on the locations that have a strong potential for value increase and intend to sell for a profit after a few years.

title: How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors

Step-by-Step Property Buying Process
The process of how to buy a house in London follows these key stages:
Setting your budget and investment objectives,
Getting a financing or mortgage agreement in principle,
Hiring a property lawyer,
Researching areas and looking at properties,
Putting in an offer and negotiating terms,
Arranging for surveys and legal due diligence,
Exchanging contracts and paying the deposit
Then finalizing the purchase and taking possession are the general steps you should follow when purchasing a property.

title: How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors
heading: Complete Cost Breakdown and Budgeting
text:
Complete Cost Breakdown and Budgeting
Understanding the complete cost breakdown is really important. Besides the price of the property, you will have to pay Stamp Duty Land Tax at a rate of 5% for properties that cost more than £250,000 (with higher rates being applicable for additional properties), legal fees of £1,500-£3,000, survey costs of £400-£1,500, and a mortgage arrangement fee that is 1-2% of the loan value. Make a provision for the transaction costs only, which should be 3-5% of the property value.

title: How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors
heading: Financing Options for Property Investment
text:
Financing Options for Property Investment
Many investors use a mortgage when purchasing a property. Usually, a deposit of 25% is required for buy-to-let mortgages; however, a few lenders may allow 15-20% deposits. Non-residents interested in purchasing property in the UK may have questions. "How to buy a property in the UK for non-residents?" can consider the following options: mortgage lenders with international services, UK banks granting mortgages to non-residents (usually requiring 30-40% deposits), portfolio mortgages for several properties, and buying with cash.

title: How to Buy Property in London: A Complete Guide for Investors
heading: Best Areas for Property Investment in London
text:
Best Areas for Property Investment in London
Choosing the right location through a detailed strategy will bring you the most profits. East London areas such as Stratford and Canary Wharf are great because of their strong regeneration and transport links. On the other hand, South London places like Battersea and Clapham are becoming more popular with professionals. While at the same time, North London areas such as King's Cross and Islington are providing established demand, and West London, like Ealing, is offering a great environment for families. Make sure you find out about local rental yields, transport links, and development plans before you decide.

Investing in properties in the UK comes with the payment of various taxes. title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: What Is The Real Estate Cycle?
text:
What Is The Real Estate Cycle?
A real estate cycle refers to the recurring phases of expansion and contraction associated with real estate values, driven by economic, social, and political conditions. It undergoes various phases, including recovery, expansion, hyper supply, and recession.
Thus, understanding this cycle helps investors make informed decisions about when to invest or withdraw from the market, as they comprehend the supply and demand dynamics of the market. Consequently, the cycle is used to forecast periods when property values appreciate or depreciate. It also aids in estimating rental yields and determining when to buy or sell for a profit.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Phases Of The Real Estate Cycle Explained
text:
Phases Of The Real Estate Cycle Explained
The real estate cycle typically goes through four phases: Recovery, Expansion, Hyper Supply, and Recession. Each of these stages has its own indicators that tell you how the market is behaving.
Recovery
This is where the market is beginning to gain momentum after slowing down. Demand is slowly rising, but everyone still believes the market is in recession. There is little or no construction, high vacancy, and negative growth in rents. It's a silent turning point, difficult to observe but full of promise for early buyers.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Expansion
text:
Expansion
This is the positive phase. The economy is on the upswing, individuals find employment, and housing demand is higher. Occupancy levels increase, rents escalate, and developers start constructing new developments. Property prices also increase during this phase. It's largely the best time to invest in or acquire properties.
Hyper Supply
Optimism causes overbuilding. There are simply too many new buildings that are entering the market, and demand lags behind supply. Prices then decelerate, vacancy rises, and rental growth falters. Investors must be cautious here and concentrate on maintaining existing assets.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Recession
text:
Recession
Here, the prices fall, demand dries up, and houses sit empty. It may sound ghastly, but it can be the best time to find undervalued houses if you're ready financially.
How The Housing Market Cycle Affects Investment Decisions?
Each stage of the housing market cycle has an impact on your investment decision. Let’s have a look at it:
In the recovery stage, one should buy properties at depressed prices and hold them until they appreciate.
Conversely, in the expansion stage, investors need to invest in high-demand locations with high rental yields.
However, during the phase of hyper-supply, you should retain your investments and refrain from making new or risky purchases. Therefore, focus on retaining tenants and optimizing property returns.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: How The Housing Market Cycle Affects Investment Decisions?
text:
But when the housing market is facing recession, you should be wise enough to sell disappointing assets and retain cash until favorable times return. However, many experienced investors also prefer buying property during this time at lower prices.
Understanding The Life Cycle Of Real Estate Assets
A real estate asset lifecycle begins at the planning phase, proceeds through maintenance, and culminates in its disposal. It encompasses four primary stages: Planning, Acquisition, Operation, and Disposal. Each stage has a set of activities and goals for both the developer and the investor.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Planning Stage
text:
Planning Stage
Here investors identify an opportunity, assess its value, obtain the funds, and finalize the purchase.
Acquisition Stage
The building or remodeling is done to prepare the property for renting. It involves permits and managing the project from start to finish.
Operation Stage
In this stage the cash flows are derived and can take many years as property owners deal with tenants, collect rent, manage maintenance, and perform day-to-day operations.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Disposal Stage
text:
Disposal Stage
Now, you can sell your property to a new owner. Therefore, it’s time to find a buyer, prepare the property for sale, and finalize the sale.
Real Estate Market Cycle: Indicators To Watch
Monitoring the real estate cycle involves tracking the correct indicators. Economic indicators, such as employment growth and GDP, drive real estate demand. The higher people's incomes, the more they purchase or lease homes. Interest rates are also a crucial factor; low rates stimulate buying, while high rates slow the market's pace.
Government policies also have a significant influence on the real estate market cycle. Tax incentives or regulations can spur the market or shut it down. Demographics play a role as well. When populations grow or change, housing demand follows.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: How To Invest Wisely During Each Property Cycle Phase?
text:
How To Invest Wisely During Each Property Cycle Phase?
Intelligent real estate investing is not just about selecting the correct property; it’s recognizing when to purchase that property. The real estate market operates in cycles, with different risks and opportunities during each phase of the cycle. Below are ways investors can make smarter decisions throughout each phase of the property cycle:
Recognise the Market Phase
The first step is to determine the current market phase: Recovery, Expansion, Hyper Supply, or Recession. Each phase has distinct implications for asset value and rental income, as well as unique lending conditions.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Step 1: Recovery – Buy At Undervalued Prices
text:
Step 1: Recovery – Buy At Undervalued Prices
The optimal time to buy is when the market begins to show signs of recovery and properties are still available at discounted prices, but confidence levels are low. During this period, you can secure low-interest loans and be patient until property prices appreciate.
Step 2: Expansion - Increase Income And Value
When the economy begins to recover and expand, consider increasing rents, improving property conditions, and enhancing operational efficiency. Reinvest in prime locations to build equity.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Step 3: Hyper Supply – Focus On Stability, And Exit At Highs
text:
Step 3: Hyper Supply – Focus On Stability, And Exit At Highs
When oversupply is entering the marketplace and demand is softening, reduce exposure. Sell high-performing assets at peak prices, or refinance properties to raise money. Maintain quality properties, and reputable tenants.
Step 4: Recession – Defend Capital And Buy At A Discount
Avoid over-leveraging and protect your income-generating investments. Be wary of distressed properties at discounted prices and prepare for the recovery phase.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
heading: Monitoring Key Indicators Of The Market
text:
Monitoring Key Indicators Of The Market
Stay attuned to changes in interest rates, rental price movement, property prices/rates, and supply levels. These indicators will either save you from making costly errors or help you implement your next move and opportunity.
Conclusion
Understanding the real estate cycle is crucial when making informed investment decisions. Each phase of the cycle, from recovery to recession, presents unique opportunities if approached with the right strategy. Aligning investments with the cycle will minimise risks and maximise returns.

text:
What Are REITs (Real Estate Investment Trusts)?
Real estate investment trusts function as publicly traded companies which handle income-producing properties for shareholder benefit. Through REITs investors can acquire partial ownership of massive real estate developments such as skyscrapers and malls while avoiding large capital expenditures.
RIETs operate under strict international regulations and comply with established protocols. They usually fall into three main categories.
Equity REITs earn income through rental payments received from their property holdings.
Through mortgage REITs property owners have the option to secure loans or buy mortgage-backed securities.
Hybrid REITs combine both equity ownership and mortgage investment approaches.
With your understanding of REITs established, we can now investigate the reasons why they make a valuable investment choice.

The risk associated with purchasing a single holding becomes lower.
Foreign investors benefit from REITs because they can be bought and sold in stock markets, unlike physical real estate.
Shareholders receive dividend payouts that account for 80-90% of earnings, while investors benefit from consistent revenue streams.

You can invest in publicly listed real estate investment trusts (REITs). They trade on stock exchanges, which gives retail investors access to liquid investment options.
Public Non-Traded REITs are another option, but they are not traded on an exchange. These REITs are secure and less susceptible to market fluctuations.
Another option is to invest in private real estate investment trusts (REITs). They are not registered or listed, and are sold primarily to institutional investors and possess greater risk and at the same time offer higher potential.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
Have you ever had that feeling of entering into a space and getting completely relaxed, motivated, or revitalized? It's the lighting, as it can completely change the room's atmosphere and make it more beautiful and comforting.
For example, we combine traditional Arabic lighting design seamlessly with advanced technologies at Omani luxury developments like AIDA Oman properties. This results in interiors that reflect Omani tradition while offering modern comfort and ambiance. So, let’s examine the different types of lighting in interior design best suited to Oman’s unique residential complexes.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: Understanding the Role of Lighting in Interior Design
text:
Understanding the Role of Lighting in Interior Design
There is a reason why lighting is at the center of any interior space, especially within Oman's unique architectural form. Let’s have a look:
1. Sets Up The Mood And Ambience
In Omani houses, receiving guests and hosting are part of the culture. Therefore they incorporate warm, golden lighting from old-fashioned lanterns and smart lights to make their home feel more welcoming and at peace.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 2. Establishes Space and Function
text:
2. Establishes Space and Function
Every room in a home is used for a different reason, and the lighting must serve that. The kitchen, for example, needs focused task lighting, particularly over countertops and cooking areas. In Omani interiors, defining space with light is especially effective in open floor plans. Light may direct flow, define zones, and provide visual separation without physical barriers.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 3. Affects Perception of the Space
text:
3. Affects Perception of the Space
Architectural Details in Oman, such as intricate wall carvings or mosaic tiles, are highlighted by lighting, giving the space depth and drama. Even the selection of fixtures like ornate, minimalist, or traditional impacts the perception of a room. It is for this reason that knowledge of the sorts of lighting involved in interior design is important, especially in upscale Omani homes.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: Popular Types of Lighting Used in Omani Interiors
text:
Popular Types of Lighting Used in Omani Interiors
The essence of Omani home architecture is its capacity to blend tradition with innovation. Here are the types of lighting used in the interiors of Oman's luxury villas and homes.
1. Chandeliers
Chandeliers are a time-honored favorite and the pièce de résistance of most Omani decor, especially in the majlis or grand entrances. These lights are often highlighted by Arabic motifs or hand-detailed work that respects classical craftsmanship. Crystal chandeliers let you enjoy classic refinement, whereas contemporary versions help you boost your geometric motifs in brass or gold finishes.
Apart from aesthetics, chandeliers are also a primary source of light that instantly adds aura to any space. Whether an antique Moroccan piece or a minimalist modern design, the chandelier is a favorite in Omani luxury design.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 2. Recessed Lighting
text:
2. Recessed Lighting
Clean, discreet, and highly utilitarian, recessed lighting is ideal for new Omani residences. It is often used in living rooms, bedrooms, and kitchens to add even, soft lighting. Recessed lighting keeps appearances clean while delivering great lighting, particularly in properties with lower ceilings or minimalist aesthetics. We at DarGlobal prefer recessed lighting to quietly emphasize architectural elements such as ceiling coves, built-in bookshelves, or textured walls. This type of lighting creates a layered effect that seems both refined and welcoming.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 3. Pendant Lights
text:
3. Pendant Lights
Pendant lights are especially chic above dining tables, kitchen counters, or reading areas. Oman pendant lights commonly combine traditional and contemporary elements such as perforated metal shades or handblown glass with Arabic calligraphy. Their versatility allows designers to play with scale and composition. Clusters of small pendants can create a dramatic impact, while a single oversized piece can be a statement in minimalist interiors.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 4. Wall Sconces
text:
4. Wall Sconces
Omani houses use wall sconces extensively to add warmth and personality to hallways, bathrooms, and sidewalls of larger spaces. Frequently they feature Arabic lighting design elements such as lattice details or colored glass. They may supplement existing lighting fixtures or add personality as standalone decor. Sconces offer a great way to light up certain details, like paintings or architectural details, introducing multiple dimensions of depth and interest.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 5. LED Strip Lighting
text:
5. LED Strip Lighting
LED strip lights are a modern feature that combines functionality with visual beauty. They are often placed underneath the kitchen cabinets, in rear of bathroom mirrors, or along ceiling soffits to provide ambient illumination. Their energy efficiency and versatility make them a darling in luxury Oman home designs, especially in developments that seek sustainability without sacrificing aesthetics.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: Arabic Lighting Design: Blending Tradition with Modernity
text:
Arabic Lighting Design: Blending Tradition with Modernity
The heritage of Arabic culture is profoundly rooted in the architecture and interior design of Omani. Arabic lighting design transcends that heritage by embracing ornate designs, warm colors, and handmade craftsmanship. In modern houses, such a traditional look is being reinvented. Designers today combine these in minimal forms and cutting-edge lighting technologies to appeal to contemporary tastes without sacrificing cultural identity.
An example would be a classic Moroccan-type lantern equipped with intelligent lighting capabilities or low-power LEDs. This symbiotic fusion of old and new can be observed in our projects in Oman, such as The Great Escape 2 and Fairway Villas , which smoothly merge these customs into their contemporary luxury designs, resulting in nostalgic and effective interiors.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: Best Lighting Choices for Different Areas of Omani Homes & Villas
text:
Best Lighting Choices for Different Areas of Omani Homes & Villas
Each area of an Omani home requires a unique lighting solution that balances function, form, and cultural context. Here's what works best:
Majlis (Guest Reception Area)
Traditional chandeliers and wall sconces bring a sense of grandeur and hospitality, and they are perfect for welcoming guests in legit Omani style.
Living Room
Place recessed lighting for ambient illumination and floor lamps for cozy reading or conversation nooks.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: Dining
text:
Dining
Use a pendant or statement chandelier right above your dining table. This will add intimacy and elegance to every meal.
Bedrooms
Get warm ambient lighting along with stylish bedside lamps. This makes your personal space comfortable and relaxed for a restful night.
Kitchen
Opt for task lighting over work areas and under-cabinet LED strips for function and ambiance.
Bathrooms
Choose vanity lights that provide illumination for grooming. To ensure safety and functionality, you can also use moisture-resistant recessed lights.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: Hallways & Corridors
text:
Hallways & Corridors
Utilize wall sconces or motion-sensor LED lights to ensure safety and enhance architectural interest.
Outdoor Spaces (Courtyard/Garden)
Get lantern-style and solar path lights to enhance visibility while embracing traditional Omani aesthetics.
Lighting Tips for Enhancing Oman House Design Aesthetics
If you wish to take your Omani house design to the next level, adopt these five lighting tips to enhance your aesthetics.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 1. Layer Your Lighting
text:
1. Layer Your Lighting
Avoid relying on one source of light, especially when you can mix ambient, task, and recessed lighting to add depth in each room. For example, in your living room, you can have recessed lights, floor lamps, and LED strips for a contemporary flair.
2. Employ Dimmers for Flexibility
Dimmers let you control light levels based on the time of day, activity, or your mood. This is especially useful in areas such as the majlis or bedroom.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 3. Emphasize Traditional Elements
text:
3. Emphasize Traditional Elements
Use recessed lighting to showcase culturally important elements like carved wooden doors, mosaic tiling, or Arabic calligraphy, etc.. Wall sconces or LED spotlights can be used to draw attention to these beautiful elements.
4. Add Warm Tones
Warm lighting (2700K to 3000K) pairs well with earthy color palettes and organic materials that are popular in Omani interiors. It evokes feelings of hospitality and comfort, which are both core to the Omani lifestyle.

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
heading: 5. Balance Natural & Artificial Light
text:
5. Balance Natural & Artificial Light
Optimize Oman's rich sunshine by creating spaces with abundant natural light. Blend artificial lighting that complements without competing with it, such as using reflective surfaces or sheer curtains to diffuse light elegantly.
Conclusion
The kind of lighting used in the interior design in your house can not only affect how your space looks but also how it lives and feels. Be it an ethereal chandelier in your majlis, or a task light in your kitchen, or subtle wall sconces leading your way through the corridor, all you need are perfect lights to turn your home into an extraordinary space from an ordinary one.

A Glimpse into Muscat's Rich Heritage
Muscat's history is as rich and diverse as its landscape. Founded over 2,000 years ago, the city has been a thriving centre of trade and culture for centuries. Its strategic location on the ancient maritime Silk Road made it a melting pot of civilizations, with influences from Arabia, Persia, India, and Africa.
Today, remnants of this rich past can be found throughout the city. The imposing forts of Al Jalali and Al Mirani stand guard over the harbour, while the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, a masterpiece of modern Islamic architecture, showcases Oman's deep-rooted faith and cultural heritage. Stroll through the Muttrah Souq, a labyrinthine maze of shops selling spices, incense, textiles, and handicrafts, and you'll feel transported back in time.

The Hajar Mountains: Majestic Guardians of Muscat
Dominating the skyline, the Al Hajar Mountains rise majestically, their peaks piercing the sky and casting long shadows across the land. This rugged mountain range, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, offering opportunities for hiking, rock climbing, and camping.
The highest peak, Jebel Shams, also known as the "Mountain of the Sun," stands at over 3,000 metres and offers stunning panoramic views of the surrounding landscape.

FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions.
Q: Why Invest with DarGlobal?
A: DarGlobal is built for global luxury property investors seeking ROI (financial growth), ROE (pride and identity), and ROL (lasting legacy). The company specializes in luxury real estate worldwide, offering high-value, internationally branded properties.
Q: Who is DarGlobal?
A: DarGlobal develops luxury properties and branded residences in partnership with global brands. They create premium villas, co-branded residences, and luxury communities with long-term value, focusing on integrity, thoughtful design, and purposeful development.
Q: What’s ROI, ROE, and ROL?
A: ROI (Return on Investment) refers to measurable financial appreciation. ROE (Return on Ego) reflects the pride of owning exclusive branded residences. ROL (Return on Legacy) represents the long-term inheritance value of owning luxury real estate.
Q: What makes DarGlobal different?
A: DarGlobal builds with clarity, purpose, and global collaboration. Each development reflects trust, scarcity, craftsmanship, and long-term measurable value backed by decades of experience.
Q: Where does DarGlobal operate?
A: DarGlobal operates across 14 cities in 9 countries including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.
Q: What types of properties does DarGlobal offer?
A: DarGlobal develops premium residences, branded villas, resort-style properties, and co-branded luxury residences in high-demand global destinations.

Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

heading: Overview
text:
Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek.
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Stromek Emirates Foundations, a leading engineering and construction firm renowned for delivering high-quality foundational work across the region, has been awarded the contract for shoring, excavation, and piling works for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project.

heading: Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
text:
Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
15/10/2024
RAK, UAE
United Arab Emirates — Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Stromek Emirates Foundations, a leading engineering and construction firm renowned for delivering high-quality foundational work across the region, has been awarded the contract for shoring, excavation, and piling works for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project.

title: Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
heading: Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
text:
With a Gross Development Value of Dh900 million (£200 million), 'The Astera' marks Aston Martin's first venture into interior design for a real estate development in the Middle East. Set on the picturesque Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, the project will feature a mix of luxury apartments and villas, blending Aston Martin’s signature design aesthetics with Dar Global’s commitment to offering exceptional living experiences.
Stromek’s scope of work will focus on ensuring the stability and sustainability of the development's foundational elements. The firm's expertise will play a critical role in preparing the site for construction, ensuring that the project can proceed smoothly while adhering to the highest standards of safety and precision.

title: Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
heading: Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
text:
“We are thrilled to have Stromek on board for this pivotal phase of 'The Astera' project. Their proven track record of excellence in shoring, excavation, and piling work perfectly aligns with the standards we uphold at Dar Global,” said Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global . “This collaboration underscores our commitment to working with the best in the industry to deliver world-class luxury developments that will leave a lasting impact.”
The shoring, excavation, and piling works are expected to commence immediately, laying the foundation for what will soon be a landmark development on the Arabian Sea. Stromek’s appointment is a key milestone in the progress of 'The Astera,' a development that will combine iconic British design with cutting-edge engineering and craftsmanship, elevating the living experience for future residents.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
heading: Overview
text:
DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman.
DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group) – the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development, have signed an agreement recently at Expo 2020 Dubai to develop ‘AIDA’, one of the largest premium, mixed-use real estate projects located in the Yiti area in Muscat.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
heading: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text:
DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
24/03/2022
DUBAI, UAE
Project marks DarGlobal’s entry into the growing Omani market
AIDA is an ode to the glorious Sea of Oman and undisturbed nature, where high curvaceous cliffs flawlessly meet deep waters
Dubai, UAE; March 24, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group) – the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development, have signed an agreement recently at Expo 2020 Dubai to develop ‘AIDA’, one of the largest premium, mixed-use real estate projects located in the Yiti area in Muscat.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
heading: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text: The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Oman to drive the development of the property market and support the growth of Oman’s real-estate sector in accordance with Oman Vision 2040. The value of the investment in the project from both parties will reach SR6 billion, and it will be developed in three stages on an area of 3.5 million square metres.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
heading: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text: Through the partnership, DarGlobal will develop a mixed-use project in Yiti and Yankat areas, 20-minutes from Downtown Muscat, a paradise with a distinctive terrain where the earthy atmosphere envelops as part of a large master development, situated 100m above the shores and overlooking of the Sea of Oman in Muscat, comprising of 3,500 residential units of medium-sized villas, townhouses, and low-rise apartments. A place where two charming hotels of 450 rooms, a plaza filled with cafes and restaurants, a gated promenade with luxury retail and other amenities.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
heading: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text: Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said , “We are excited to become part of this unique project”. Oman has always offered an exceptional experience for residents and tourists, and the development of Yiti and Yankat areas will further elevate the nation’s offering and position it as a world-class destination. Our project in Oman builds on DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of elevating the standards and quality of the real-estate sector in the region. But most importantly, with this project, we’re working to ensure a sustainable and environmentally friendly approach to building a large, mixed-use development that fits in with the characteristics of the area. AIDA sits atop one of the world’s highest peaks, a place where all the noise is quietened, composing a beautiful symphony. Overlooking one of the most breathtaking horizons in the world will lie a place bubbling with inspiration.”

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
heading: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text: Hashil Bin Obaid Al Mahrouqi, CEO of OMRAN Group, said: “We are delighted to work with DarGlobal on this master project that is being developed with world class expertise. We believe they share the same vision with regards to balanced and sustainable building practices, and this is a critical factor in the success of this project. The project is strategically designed as an extension to Muscat city to showcase the vision of progress and sustainable urbanisation. AIDA will become an attractive and sought-after destination with its many residential, entertainment, cultural, retail and recreational offerings that will put Oman on the regional and global tourism map, as well as drive foreign investment and stimulate key economic sectors that will help achieve Oman Vision 2040.”

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
heading: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text:
The project is one of the largest urban developments in Oman, extending to a total area of over 11 million square kilometres. The project masterplan was designed to ensure innovative standards in urban development and place-creation, and the adoption of architectural foundations in harmony with the rich natural surroundings.
In line with the Sultanate’s ambitious plans for economic diversification, the project plays a pivotal role in increasing the contribution of the tourism sector to support the national GDP. Based on the position of OMRAN Group as the active national arm in the development of the tourism sector, the project will contribute to providing promising investment opportunities and creating a fertile environment to attract capital and foreign direct investment.

DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, and Italian Hypercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili, unveiled the first apartment at the magnificent DaVinci tower located in Downtown Dubai. 06/10/2022
DUBAI, UAE
Dubai, UAE; October 6, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, and Italian Hypercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili, unveiled the first apartment at the magnificent DaVinci tower located in Downtown Dubai. The apartment, a residential masterpiece, gave prospective buyers a glimpse into the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired exclusive space as well as the uniqueness of the Da Vinci tower’s apartment portfolio.

title: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
heading: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
text:
Reflecting the cornerstone of Horacio Pagani’s creative philosophy that combines form and function to create unique, handmade objects, all 80 apartments will be adorned with tailored pieces from the line of Pagani branded furniture. This, combined with a blend of high-end marble and wooden flooring dotted with chevron patterns, doors bearing the Pagani emblem, and custom lighting, is nothing short of captivating.
The three-bedroom apartment redefines the dimensions of space for those looking to make Dubai their home. It also demonstrated a unique confluence of Italian and contemporary design excellence that is slated to characterise the entire inventory, epitomising Pagani’s craftmanship and emphasising the concept of Living Above Luxury.

title: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
heading: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
text: Horacio Pagani, Founder & Chief Designer, Pagani Automobili S.p.A. said: “It is exhilarating to see the Pagani brand essence come to life in the interior and furniture design space, for the first time in the world. This apartment will bear witness to what the DaVinci tower is set to bring to Dubai in the form of one of the world’s most sought-after addresses. We are proud of our partnership with DarGlobal, as it marks a key step forward in our long-term growth strategy to further consolidate our positioning as an iconic brand globally.”

title: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
heading: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
text:

The DaVinci tower is slated to set a new benchmark as a true work of art, and I am confident that the unveiling of the first apartment will further fortify our clientele’s trust in our ability to create a life of exclusivity for them.”
While Pagani’s signature style will be weaved in all corners of the apartments, every room will have a distinct character. From the kitchen, with its Italian design and welcoming feel, to the car simulator room, exemplifying a perfect man cave with its leather padded walls and cockpit-inspired shape, these one-of-a-kind apartments will set a new standard for contemporary living.

title: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
heading: DarGlobal and Pagani Automobili give customers a glimpse of the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired living space
text:

A stunning 800 million development, DaVinci tower features high-end one, two, and three-bedroom apartments and a uber luxurious penthouse shaped like a globe with a private elevator. The common areas will be well appointed with a fully equipped gymnasium, swimming pool, and a stunning sky garden, all designed with utmost attention to detail. Residents will also have access to additional luxury facilities and services. The tower will also have a grand lobby with a 24/7 concierge and security service.
So, if you are looking for a home unlike any other, come discover the world of Pagani with us at the DaVinci Tower.

Inspired by the sea and luxury island living, Les Vagues residences embody the sophisticated elegance of ELIE SAAB designs
Dubai, UAE; March 23, 2022: The Qatar Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai hosted the launch of Les Vagues residences by ELIE SAAB, a luxury residential project that’s being developed by DarGlobal, the leading real-estate company in Saudi Arabia, and Qetaifan Projects, a leading Qatari real estate development company fully owned by Katara Hospitality.

heading: DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
text: The exclusive residences by the world-renowned designer reflect the sophisticated elegance and exceptional detailing that ELIE SAAB is recognised for in fashion and lifestyle, setting new standards for modern luxury living in Qatar. Taking inspiration from the unimaginable beauty and serenity of the sea, grand shores, and infinite horizons surrounding Qetaifan Island North, Les Vagues, which means waves in French, have been exquisitely designed as an ode to luxury island life with clean and contemporary lines softened by carefully selected palms and tropical foliage.

After our successful project launch with the master of design himself, Elie Saab, in Riyadh we’re collaborating for a second time on this premium residential project in one of the region’s most sought-after developments. Our project on Qetaifan Island North is unique and builds on the DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of regional and global expansion through superior, high-quality real-estate projects that cater to discerning clientele from across the world.”

text: Elie Saab Jr, CEO of ELIE SAAB Group, commented: “We are delighted to collaborate with DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects on this premium residential project that is inspired by the natural beauty of the island and its magnificent surroundings. Les Vagues is a project that embodies architectural and lifestyle expression of our brand delivering exceptional and timeless experiences through luxury real-estate projects that are unmatched globally.”

title: DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
heading: DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
text: HE Sheikh Nasser Bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, Managing Director, Qetaifan Projects, said: “Following our concerted efforts to provide the local market with international standards that work on developing and revitalizing sectors such as tourism, hospitality, entertainment and of course real estate development, we are happy to bring a new innovative project to Qatar. We’re looking forward to working with DarGlobal and ELIE SAAB, a global pioneer in design, on this premium project that is unlike any other in the region. Qetaifan Island North is being developed as the first touristic entertainment destination in Qatar, that will put the country on the regional and global tourism map, and Les Vagues residences is an integral project within the masterplan of the development.”

title: DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
heading: DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
text:
Les Vagues feature opulent one, two and three-bedroom sea-front residencies with a variety of majestic balconies and terraces and floor-to ceiling windows for residents to enjoy uninterrupted panoramic views of the sea.
The interiors perfectly embody the beauty of ELIE SAAB’s designs, leaving a lasting impression of refined elegance and spectacular grace where shapes and colors blend harmoniously. Special attention has been given to the finishes with exquisite craftsmanship, exceptional level of quality and aesthetic appeal in pure ELIE SAAB style.

title: DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
heading: DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
text:
The amenities at Les Vagues are tailored to the residents’ needs, featuring à la carte concierge services as well as a state-of-the-art fitness center, an infinity swimming pool, a landscaped community courtyard with sea views, a 24-hour reception desk, public areas furniture from ELIE SAAB Maison Collection, luxury retail outlets, and parking for all residential units.
DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects signed the agreement to develop a premium residential and lifestyle project on Qetaifan Island North last October. The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Qatar with the aim of driving the development of the luxury property market and support the growth of Qatar’s real-estate sector.
Work on the development will start in Q2 2022, and total sales are expected to reach over 1 billion Qatari Riyal.

Riyadh, KSA; November 20, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, and The Trump Organization signed an agreement in New York for the development of a signature Trump Resort, including residential villas, a hotel, and a golf course in the stunning AIDA project. Located in the heart of the capital, Muscat, the 100-meter-high hilltop development is one of the largest premium mixed-use real estate projects in the world, situated directly by the sea. Yousef Al Shelash, Chairman, DarGlobal, said: “The Trump Organization is known for its exclusive, world-class developments. Superior quality, detail, and perfection are the standards that Trump demands throughout its projects – from residential to resort, from hotel to golf, and from commercial office to retail.

text: We are always looking to enhance DarGlobal’s unique projects with premium facilities and experiences, and our partnership with Trump will distinguish our first project in Oman and put it on the global map.” Eric Trump, Executive Vice President, The Trump Organization, said: “When we were looking at our next project and where we wanted to expand our footprint, we knew it had to be in an outstanding location and with an amazing team. At AIDA, in the heart of Muscat, Oman situated directly overlooking the incredible sea, we have truly found that. Together with DarGlobal, we are going to deliver an exceptional Trump Golf resort with the finest residential villas, a world-class hotel, and an iconic golf course, all in one of the most beautiful settings.”

Imagine the beautiful setting of a villa in these majestic surroundings or playing a game of golf overlooking the sea – it is truly unrivalled. We are confident the relationship with Trump will enhance the natural beauty of AIDA and attract end-users and investors from around the world looking to be part of an exceptionally iconic project.”
AIDA will be developed with the support of Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group), the executive arm of the Sultanate of Oman for tourism development.
